_comment: Ports listed by Mixtape in addition to the MiyooMini-Ports catalog (same fields, plus an optional inline 'recipe' with the fields described in assets/recipes.json). If MiyooMini-Ports adds the same project, its entry wins.

ports.name: Panel Attack
ports.notes: Tetris Attack / Puzzle League clone with online play on panelattack.com. Wi-Fi needed for online. Set a name before going online.

ports.name: MiniAmp
ports.notes: Classic-skin music player: MP3/FLAC/OGG/WAV, .wsz skins with a skin browser, 10-band EQ, visualizers, screen-off playback. Add skins to MiniAmp/skins.
